text:
Ada: Quick sync — proposing a short, tightly scoped PLG experiment that ties a 30-min webinar + starter credits + 3 prompt templates into a single activation funnel. Hypothesis: bundled experience will lift 'first 3 min usage' by ~20% over baseline. KT? 
Mike: Love it. What's the primary activation metric and measurement window?
Ada: Primary: percent of new signups who generate >=3 successful model calls in first 72 hours. Secondary: 7-day retention, avg tokens/week.
Sofia: Cohort segmentation? free credits only, webinar registrants only, and combined (webinar + credits). Need control group.
Samir: Suggest power calc: baseline activation ~12%, target 14.4% (20% relative). For 80% power alpha .05 we need ~1.6k users per arm. Can we route that much in 2-week window?
Ada: Good point. Initial run 2 weeks, but we can stagger across 4 weeks if traffic low. Aim for n=1k per arm minimum.
Mike: Landing page + webinar RSVP flow will be main traffic driver. Also pulse promo via tweet + product community. I'll sketch copy.
Sofia: For the prompt templates, propose 3 micro-templates: "Sales cold email", "Product roadmap brainstorming", "Data-to-insights prompt". Keep them short and starter-friendly.
Samir: Tracking: use campaign params and a funnel id. Example query params: ?src=webinar_vignette&arm=combo_v1&credit=50. Also set user_provisioned_credit_tag in metadata.
Ada: Love the params. Put the canonical tracking snippet in docs:
```
/track?utm_source=webinar_vignette&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=launch_vignette_v1&arm=combo_v1
```
Sofia: Copy notes: webinar landing should emphasize "ready-to-run prompts" and "instant credits to try". CTA: "Reserve seat + claim starter credits" not just "Register".
Mike: I'll A/B the CTA text: "Reserve seat + claim credits" vs "Register — get starter credits". Small change, could matter.
Samir: Backend ops: we'll create 3 promo codes for the cohorts. OnboardBot, can you reserve code pool and ensure codes attach to user on first login? @OnboardBot
OnboardBot: Promo pool created: launch_vignette_pool (5000 codes). Integration hook: /api/assign_code?user_id=... responds with code and expiry 14 days.
Ada: Nice — please make sure codes are single-use and tied to account id. Also set expiry to 14 days.
Sofia: Webinar format: 20min demo (how to use templates + quick wins), 10min Q&A, 1-min CTA to claim credits + templates. We'll include a short benchmark slide: "3-minute quickstart: typical cost & latency for sample prompt".
Mike: Benchmarks: we'll show 3 workloads (short chat, code completion, embedding) with tokens and latency. I'll request the eng-runtime team for up-to-date latency numbers.
Samir: Can we include a lightweight micro-eval to validate quality across models? Something like success rate on 5 prompt items; show expected outputs.
Ada: Yes — that'll help set expectations and reduce disappointment which kills retention. Keep it transparent.
Sofia: Measurement plan: event schema: signup.source, promo_code, webinar_reg, first_gen_ts, gen_count_72h, retention_d7. Need QA on instrumentation.
Samir: I'll add a validation checklist. Also recommend a fallback email drip for people who registered but didn't claim credits within 48 hours.
Mike: Timing: target webinar in 2 weeks. Draft landing + email + social assets by EOD Friday?
Ada: Can everyone confirm tasks? Mike - landing & ASSETS; Sofia - templates + webinar script; Samir - tracking + promo codes; I'll own measurement and experiment doc.
Mike: Confirmed. I'll post first draft by Thursday lunchtime. :thumbsup:
Sofia: Confirmed. Will iterate templates in a public doc.
Samir: Confirmed. Will coordinate with infra for assignment webhook.
Ada: Sweet. If we hit minimum cohort size early we can stop recruitment, otherwise extend. Weekly sync next Wed 9am PT.
Mike: One small ask: add a short social benchmark narrative for the post — "how we got 3x faster time-to-first-prompt" style. Keep it factual.
Sofia: I'll draft 2 narrative variants: technical audience vs product managers.
Ada: Great. Thanks team. 
OnboardBot: Reminder: webhook /api/assign_code requires service token; rotateable via /secrets. Next scheduled maintenance window 1844500000-1844540000 UTC.
Ada: Noted — avoid rollout during maintenance.
Mike: I'll schedule the send outside that window.
Sofia: One more: can we add an inline example snippet for users on the landing page to run immediately? Small code block helps lower friction.
Ada: Yes — 1-click run via console is ideal, but at minimum provide quick curl + sample prompt.
Samir: For A/B analysis, label cohorts as arm_control | arm_credits | arm_webinar | arm_combo. We'll track via cohort tags.
Ada: Perfect. Wrapping up — will draft the experiment brief and post the link here when ready. :rocket:
